output.rationale: Each step re-slices and re-sums the whole window, O(n·w). Keeping a running total and adding the entering value minus the leaving one is O(n); results agree to rounding error.
output.code:
def moving_average(values: list[float], window: int) -> list[float]:
    """Return the mean of every run of ``window`` consecutive values.

    The result has ``len(values) - window + 1`` entries (none when the series
    is shorter than the window). Raises ``ValueError`` if ``window`` is not
    positive.
    """
    if window <= 0:
        raise ValueError("window must be positive")
    if len(values) < window:
        return []
    total = sum(values[:window])
    averages = [total / window]
    for i in range(window, len(values)):
        total += values[i] - values[i - window]
        averages.append(total / window)
    return averages
